dialogues.speaker: Mischievous Aranara
dialogues.text: You found me? Aranara thought it was a good hiding spot... If Aranara went into the dirt, then Nara would be at a total loss, right?

dialogues.speaker: Mischievous Aranara
dialogues.text: Ah! If Nara doesn't find Aranara and just walks away... Then for how long does Aranara have to lie in the dirt? No, that's not acceptable at all!
